Splits each layer horizontally (weight matrix shards)
Comm: All-reduce per layer | Scope: Within node (NVLink)
Splits model vertically by layer groups (stages)

all-to-all: route tokens → expert GPU → gather results
Replicates full model; each replica gets different data
Comm: All-reduce per step (gradient sync) | Low frequency
DP = total_GPUs / (TP x PP x CP) — implicit, not set directly
Splits sequence length across GPUs (ring attention)
For very long contexts. CP=1 in all current configs.
Seq [0..T/2] on GPU 0, Seq [T/2..T] on GPU 1, etc.
Alternative backend: shards params + grads + optim states
Simpler setup. Best for models ≤ 72B. No TP/PP/EP needed.
Megatron is 2.7x faster on this cluster (measured; see docs/results.md)
Dense Model: Qwen2.5-72B | TP=4, PP=4, DP=3 | 48 GPUs
Each DP replica = 16 GPUs (4 TP per stage x 4 pipeline stages). 3 replicas process different batches in parallel.
Gradient All-Reduce across 3 DP Replicas (once per training step, via EFA)
MoE Model: Qwen3-235B-A22B | TP=4, PP=1, EP=4 | 48 GPUs (128 experts, 94 layers)
DP=12 TP groups. EP groups of 4 share experts via all-to-all. Effective DP = 12/4 = 3 replicas. 32 experts per GPU.
(4 DP ranks share 128 experts via all-to-all)
All-to-All token dispatch + combine (94 MoE layers x fwd+bwd = 376 ops/step)
Gradient All-Reduce across 3 Effective DP Replicas (once per step, via EFA)
Min needed for per-layer weights to fit in GPU memory. Keep within node (≤8).
Constraint: num_attention_heads % TP == 0 AND num_kv_heads % TP == 0
If expert params dominate memory, increase EP. Must divide num_experts AND DP.
Constraint: num_experts % EP == 0 AND DP % EP == 0
Only if TP + EP can't fit model. PP=1 is always best for throughput.
Constraint: num_layers should be roughly divisible by PP. TP x PP must divide total GPUs.
DP = total_GPUs / (TP x PP x CP). Effective DP = DP / EP. More DP = faster training.
Not explicitly configured — it is whatever is left over.
Concrete Configurations from This Cluster (48 B200 GPUs, 6 nodes)
Key Insight: PP vs EP Tradeoff for MoE Models
Qwen3-235B first tried TP=4, PP=2, EP=1 → OOM (128 experts on every GPU = ~57 GB expert memory alone).
Switching to TP=4, PP=1, EP=4 → 32 experts/GPU (~14 GB) + zero pipeline bubbles. PP distributes layers; EP distributes experts.
Highest bandwidth demand — stays on NVLink
Token routing across EP group (376 ops/step)
Global: DP Gradient All-Reduce (across all nodes, once per training step)
Synchronizes gradients across effective DP replicas. Overlapped with backward computation where possible.
Communication per training step (Qwen3-235B, TP=4 EP=4):
TP: 94 x all-reduce (NVLink, fast) EP: 376 x all-to-all (EFA, moderate) DP: 1 x all-reduce (EFA, large but infrequent)
